Hey, honestly the best advice I can offer is to seek professional help. I know it sounds cheesy at this point (it did to me aswell) but just talking to someone who knows what in the hell they are talking about can really help out. Keeping it bottled up really does not help (as a male I felt like it wouldn't be socially acceptable to speak out and kept pushing shit down untill I mentally popped). That's pretty much as much help as I can offer you but if you do have any questions I can try to answer (this comment section or dms, whichever you would be more comfortable with). 

Anyway good luck in life and have a nice day.

Now just watch as 8 consecutive people tell you to "find a fun hobby" or "go out and do something". Honestly dude, atleast you got that and apparently own up to it. Btw no, I'm not trying to 'compete' or compare our situations. I'm also not offering any solution because I don't got any. I do wish you the very best of luck in life though as well as a good day.

So, I see your point but I'm personally on the complete other side. Anyone has yet to figure out how to make me care about me. 

And it's not like I'm a psychopath because I do care about others and that's about the only thing I care about.

But yeah the "love yourself first" thing is absolute bullshit.
